description: This file contains unit tests for the `ReportGeneratorService` class within the OrangeHRM project. It sets up test data, mocks dependencies, and verifies multiple functionalities such as report type checking, header definition retrieval, and report data normalization.

classes.name: ReportGeneratorServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for `ReportGeneratorService` verifying report generation and data normalization functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of `ReportGeneratorService`, and populates test data fixtures.

methods.name: testIsPimReport
methods.description: Tests whether reports are correctly identified as PIM reports based on report ID.

methods.name: testGetHeaderDefinitionByReportId
methods.description: Verifies correct retrieval and normalization of report header definitions for a specific report ID.

methods.name: testGetNormalizedReportData
methods.description: Checks that normalized report data matches expected values for report ID 5.

methods.name: testGetNormalizedReportDataForPastEmployees
methods.description: Validates report data normalization for past employees with report ID 6.
